# PiTTy 1.2.7

## Version in the UI

- Show the running PiTTy version at the bottom right of the existing footer, in a muted style. The version remains visible with the sidebar hidden.
- Display the version embedded in the current executable, not the latest available release or a staged update.
- Reserve enough footer width for the version. Shortcut hints shrink before the version, without adding a new UI row.
- Add render checks for narrow and wide terminal widths.

Existing sessions, credentials, models, and running agents remain unchanged. A staged update activates on the next launch.
